title: GabberPrincipalClassLocallyZero
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $X=\operatorname{Spec}R$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], and $F$ an abelian sheaf on $X_{\mathrm{Et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. Write $F|_{D(a)}$ for inverse image along the open immersion $D(a)\to X$ [def-weil-open-immersion] [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], and use etale cohomology [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. Assume every prime localization $R_{\mathfrak p}$ is strictly henselian [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology]. Let $q>0$, $h\in R$, and $\xi\in H^q(D(h),F|_{D(h)})$. For $f\in R$ let $\rho_{h,f}^q:H^q(D(h),F|_{D(h)})\to H^q(D(fh),(D(fh)\to D(h))^{-1}(F|_{D(h)}))$ be the pullback [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]. Then every prime $\mathfrak p$ avoiding $h$ avoids some $f\in R$ with $\rho_{h,f}^q(\xi)=0$.

source.place: Lemma 0GY0 (label lemma-gabber-criterion), proof: simultaneous induction on all principal opens, local triviality, and the ideal of vanishing restrictions.

proof.text: For p avoiding h, regard p as a point x of D(h). Compose the restriction stalk isomorphism with Spec.stalkIso to identify O_D(h),x with R_p. Transport strict henselianity along this ring isomorphism. The upstream Scheme.subsingleton_H_of_isStrictlyHenselianLocalRing makes the pullback of ξ to Spec O_D(h),x zero in degree q>0. This uses the already proved Ext-valued upstream theorem directly, rather than the derived-cohomology declaration recorded on the acyclicity node; both express the same strict-local acyclicity argument.

Apply the vanishing-spreads theorem to obtain an open U of D(h) containing x where ξ dies. Its image W in Spec R is open. Choose D(f) containing p inside W, and refine to D(fh). The map D(fh) → D(h) factors through U, via the open-immersion isoImage. Pullback composition and injectivity of the coefficient-comparison map show that ξ dies on D(fh). Membership p in D(f) gives f outside p.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 0GY0, local triviality paragraph, via strict-local acyclicity (Tag 03QO) and the local-ring colimit argument of Lemma 09AX (using Tags 03Q6, 09YQ and 03F3).
